qualifier: lipid droplet storage and glycerol backbone
name: Triglyceride storage, lipid droplets and glycerol metabolism
rationale: Members cover triglyceride/DAG/PA synthesis and lipolysis, lipid droplet formation, fusion and lipophagy, adipose lipid storage and glycerol/alditol metabolism, which separates them from adipocyte differentiation/thermogenesis, phospholipid remodelling, fatty acid oxidation and insulin/glucose signalling neighbours.

qualifier: macrophage proliferation via autocrine/paracrine cytokine signals
name: CSF1 receptor signaling driving macrophage proliferation
rationale: Members centre on M-CSF/CSF1 signalling in myeloid cells, interleukin receptor SHC signalling, SIRP interactions and autocrine/paracrine control of macrophage proliferation, unlike neighbours about GM-CSF production and differentiation, IL-6, monocyte identity or DAP12.

qualifier: checkpoint restraint of meiotic phase transitions
name: Meiotic checkpoints restraining meiotic phase transitions
rationale: All members regulate (mostly negatively) meiotic progression - G2/MI, metaphase/anaphase, chromosome separation and nuclear division via checkpoint signalling - whereas neighbours concern chiasma, cohesion, chromosome alignment and female meiotic spindles.

qualifier: chemorepulsion and monoaminergic neuron axon pathfinding
name: Axon chemorepulsion and monoaminergic neuron axon guidance
rationale: Members are axon guidance processes (chemorepulsion, inhibited extension, anterior/posterior guidance, DRG development) including dopaminergic and serotonergic axon guidance, which the commissural SLIT/ROBO, Sema3A/netrin and axon-extension neighbours lack.

qualifier: retinoid, BMP and PAX3 programs
name: Differentiation-linked G0 entry via retinoid, BMP and PAX3 programs
rationale: Members control G1-to-G0 transition and cytostatic arrest during differentiation together with retinoic acid receptor, BMP/TGF-beta and PAX3 target programs, distinguishing them from thyroid hormone receptor, CDH1/PTEN transcription and TP53-driven arrest neighbours.

qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase, coenzyme A and Fe-S enzyme maturation
name: TCA cycle, pyruvate oxidation and coenzyme A synthesis
rationale: Members are TCA cycle steps and intermediates, PDH-catalysed pyruvate oxidation, pantothenate/CoA biosynthesis and Fe-S assembly for TCA enzymes, separating them from OGDH/lipoylation neighbours and from the malate-aspartate shuttle/transport neighbour.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide-controlled intrinsic apoptosis
name: Oxidative and hypoxic stress responses governing intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members are responses to H2O2, nitrosative stress, hydrogen sulfide, ischemia and oxygen, mostly as regulation of intrinsic apoptosis, whereas neighbours focus on nitric oxide sensing or ferroptosis and respiration control.

qualifier: death receptor apoptosis and TRIF/RIPK1 necroptosis
name: Caspase-8 death receptor apoptosis and TRIF-driven necroptosis
rationale: Members are TRAIL and FasL death receptor signalling, procaspase-8 activation, c-FLIP, BID cleavage and TLR3/TRIF- or microbe-modulated RIPK1 necroptosis, unlike neighbours about T cell activation-induced death, TLR3-IRF3 signalling or necrosis regulation.

qualifier: tetrahydrobiopterin-dependent synthesis and MAO/COMT degradation
name: Monoamine synthesis, tetrahydrobiopterin and MAO/COMT degradation
rationale: Members cover catecholamine and serotonin biosynthesis with its BH4 cofactor and their oxidative deamination/methylation by MAO and COMT, which separates them from neighbours about monoamine, GABA and glutamate transport and uptake.

qualifier: atypical RHOBTB and Ral GTPases
name: RHOBTB and Ral small GTPase activity regulation
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles and effectors (RHOBTB1-3, Rhotekin/Rhophilin, Ral) and GTPase activity regulation with cell-surface localization, unlike neighbours about Rab/ARF GTPases, Golgi organization, membrane rafts or nuclear transport.

qualifier: phosphocreatine shuttle, adenine nucleotide exchange and magnesium
name: Phosphocreatine shuttle, ADP/ATP exchange and magnesium homeostasis
rationale: Most members concern creatine/phosphocreatine metabolism, mitochondrial ADP/ATP transport and magnesium transport/homeostasis (Mg-ATP), with inositol transport and calcium-independent adhesion as outliers; neighbours concern aquaporins, chloride cotransport and protein oligomerization.

qualifier: retinol uptake and esterification defects impairing vision
name: Vitamin A metabolism defects impairing visual phototransduction
rationale: Members are vitamin A metabolism and its disease events, namely visual phototransduction defects from STRA6, LRAT and RDH12 loss, distinct from the rod/cone retinoid cycle and retinoic acid metabolism neighbours.

qualifier: ependymal brain ventricle and cerebrospinal fluid flow
name: Ependymal multiciliogenesis and cerebrospinal fluid circulation
rationale: Members are multiciliated-cell transcription, de novo centriole and basal body assembly together with lateral/third ventricle development and CSF circulation, which motile axoneme, sperm, centrosome and left/right asymmetry neighbours lack.

qualifier: neuronal death upon ligand absence
name: Dependence receptor-triggered neuronal apoptosis upon ligand absence
rationale: Members are caspase activation by dependence receptors (NTRK3, NRAGE-JNK) without ligand and neuronal apoptosis regulation, distinct from neighbours on p75NTR/NGF binding, anoikis and FOXO/CDK5 death programs.

qualifier: inhibitory synapse assembly via GABA receptor and gephyrin clustering
name: Inhibitory synapse assembly and postsynaptic potential regulation
rationale: Members are GABA receptor and gephyrin clustering, inhibitory synapse assembly and regulation of excitatory/inhibitory postsynaptic potentials, unlike neighbours on NMDA/PSD-95 excitatory synapse assembly or presynaptic calcium and release.

qualifier: RNA polymerases I, II and III including rRNA and HIV transcription
name: Transcription cycle of RNA polymerases I, II and III
rationale: Members are initiation, promoter escape, elongation/pausing and termination by Pol I, II and III (incl. rRNA expression control, MYC targets and HIV Tat elongation), whereas neighbours concern RNA processing, splicing, decay and ribosome assembly.

qualifier: spinal motor/interneurons and midbrain dopaminergic neurons
name: Spinal motor and midbrain dopaminergic neuron specification
rationale: Members are dorsoventral neural tube and spinal cord patterning, motor neuron and interneuron specification, and midbrain dopaminergic differentiation and monoaminergic axon guidance, which hindbrain, floor plate and axial mesoderm neighbours lack.

qualifier: HDL and LDL
name: HDL and LDL particle remodeling
rationale: All members are HDL or LDL remodeling, while neighbours concern assembly, remodeling and clearance of triglyceride-rich chylomicrons and VLDL.

qualifier: dicarboxylate transport, malate-aspartate shuttle and CoA synthesis
name: Pyruvate oxidation, CoA synthesis and TCA intermediate transport
rationale: Members are PDH pyruvate oxidation, CoA/pantothenate synthesis, TCA intermediates and their SLC transport and malate-aspartate shuttle, which distinguishes them from glutamate/nitrogen, succinate-oxidation and gluconeogenesis neighbours.

qualifier: AMPA receptor activity and diffusion trapping
name: AMPA receptor trapping in excitatory synaptic transmission
rationale: Members are excitatory transmission, short-term plasticity, AMPA receptor activity and receptor diffusion trapping, unlike neighbours on kainate receptors, GABA and presynaptic G-protein/calcium control.

core: T and B lymphocyte development and activation
qualifier: germinal centre Tfh-B cell cooperation
name: T and B lymphocyte activation in germinal centre responses
rationale: Members span T and B cell development and activation with Tfh differentiation, ICOS costimulation and germinal centre B differentiation, whereas neighbours are B-only signatures/BCR signalling or T-only TCR, thymic and CD28 programs.

qualifier: ribonucleoside level and guanine
name: Purine ribonucleoside salvage and guanine metabolism
rationale: All three members are purine (ribonucleoside) salvage and guanine metabolism, while neighbours cover HPRT1 nucleobase salvage, purine catabolism and deoxyribonucleoside metabolism.

qualifier: aldosterone regulation and CYP enzyme deficiencies
name: Adrenal corticosteroid synthesis, aldosterone regulation and CYP defects
rationale: Members are mineralocorticoid, glucocorticoid and androgen synthesis, aldosterone and cortisol regulation and steroidogenic CYP defects, distinct from neighbours on pregnenolone, progesterone, estrogen and testosterone regulation.

qualifier: dystroglycan complex and neuromuscular synapse assembly
name: Muscle basement membrane, dystroglycan complex and neuromuscular synapse
rationale: Members are laminin and proteoglycan basement membrane assembly, dystrophin-glycoprotein complex formation, NMJ synapse and AChR clustering and myogenesis, unlike neighbours on DAG1 glycosylation, sarcomere contraction or collagen fibrils.

qualifier: late sterol steps and oxysterol bile acid routes with spastic paraplegia defects
name: Late cholesterol synthesis and oxysterol bile acid pathways
rationale: Members are late Bloch/Kandutsch-Russell cholesterol synthesis and 24-/27-hydroxycholesterol bile acid synthesis with related CYP and SLC33A1 defects, unlike neighbours on peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation, the 7alpha-hydroxycholesterol route or early mevalonate steps.
